thread:
mike: heads-up — the quant8 bring-up on model-x surfaced a weird drop on our gold set for short-context prompts. seeing ~6% BLEU-like reduction on paraphrase tasks.

aya: hmm — is that confined to short windows (<128 tokens) or across the board?

mike: seems concentrated <128. long-context (>512) mostly fine. hypothesis: quant kernels hitting prefix compression boundary. also our goldset has a lot of near-duplicates that bias metrics.

sanjay: can we repro locally on a dev shard? if it's de-dupe causing the issue we should confirm with a fingerprinted holdout.

mike: repro script: ```python tools/eval/run_eval.py --model model-x-quant8 --promptset tests/goldset_v3.jsonl --metrics sacrebleu,exact_match --limit 2000``` ran on g4dn-16. attaching logs.

aya: ok can you generate a deduped version with rolling-window fingerprint and rerun? I've been pushing rolling-window fp for short-context dedupe because exact hashes miss paraphrases.

mike: started rolling-window dedupe job: ```./bin/fp_tool --mode rolling --window 64 --min_overlap 0.8 --input goldset_v3.jsonl --out goldset_v3_fp.jsonl --shards 50``` ETA ~12m.

labeling-bot: labeling job queued: gold-review-2412 (50 tasks) — assign @leah when ready.

leah: happy to take the review. what's the acceptance criteria for rebalancing? do we keep coverage across intent buckets?

aya: yes — keep per-intent proportions within +/-3pp and ensure no more than 10% of gold is synthetic-augmented. we want natural examples prioritized for model regression signal.

mike: dedupe finished. rolling dedupe removed 18% entries (mostly micro-paraphrases). reran eval on the deduped gold: degradation reduced to ~1.3% and failures correlate with quantized attention in short prefixes.

sanjay: that suggests two things: 1) our prior gold set was inflating the regression due to duplicate-heavy signal, and 2) there is a small quant edge-case still worth fixing or mitigating.

leah: starting manual review of the 360 dropped examples to ensure we didn't drop rare intents accidentally. labeling task link: https://internal/labels/2412

aya: for the small residual regression — can we add an ephemeral fallback rule for <128 tokens to route to model-x-quant8-fp (less aggressive quant)? not ideal long term but buys time.

mike: yes we can try a policy toggle in routing: ```if seq_len < 128 and model == model-x: use model-x-quant8-fp else model-x-quant8``` will test in canary.

leah: manual review found ~22 examples where dedupe removed legitimate paraphrase variants (edge paraphrase pairs). I'll put them into a holdout-bucket to seed a refactor of the rolling window threshold.

sanjay: action items: 1) mike to run canary with fallback policy (24h) 2) leah to finalize the refined goldset (holdout + revised dedupe thresholds) 3) aya to coordinate quant kernel team with logs (stack traces attached).

mike: will run canary at 2412345900 and share traces.

aya: thanks — also open a short postmortem doc so we capture golden set bias risk. small note: recommend adding fingerprint diversity metric to our gold acceptance checks (unique_fp_ratio <-> expected range).

labeling-bot: task update: gold-review-2412 marked in-progress by leah.

leah: dropping a quick sample CSV of the 360 removed entries for visibility: https://internal/drive/gold-review-2412/sample.csv — tagging @sanjay for sampling checks.

mike: thanks everyone. will update thread after canary. :thumbsup:
